column1: # note: The 2025 Vermont Tax Rate Schedules, every printed row. Between the rows up to $75,000 and those over it the schedules print "taxable income under $75,000 use the tax tables"; the test checks them from $75,000, where the row ending at $75,000 still holds $75,000 itself.
# note: Schedule X is single; Y-1 married filing jointly, qualifying widow(er) and civil union filing jointly (repeated as mfj and qss); Y-2 married filing separately; Z head of household.
# note: The instructions round entries to the nearest whole dollar (page 3).
# note: Line 8 is the greater of this and 3% of adjusted gross income when AGI exceeds $150,000; that alternative is not in this schedule.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
